# Conformance

<!-- Generated by `cargo run -p pgmem-conformance -- --update`; do not edit. -->

The corpus in [`conformance/`](conformance/) is SQL whose expected results were recorded from
PostgreSQL 18; CI re-verifies every record against PostgreSQL and runs it against pgmem.
A record passes when pgmem returns the same column names, column types and text values, or
the same SQLSTATE and error message.

pgmem passes **2132 / 3309 records (64.4%)**.
